name: hud_ui_timer_panel_update_hms_from_seconds
description: HudUiTimerPanel::UpdateHMSFromSeconds stores elapsed seconds, splits it into hours/minutes/seconds, and updates the timer text.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja still has a call-rendering limitation around the final three SetTimeSeconds arguments, but assembly and smoke coverage agree on the contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40ee60 validates elapsed-second storage at offset 0x2a4, floor-based hour/minute/second decomposition, and the SetTimeSeconds call.
The native timer-panel update-HMS smoke verifies elapsed-second storage and rendered HH:MM:SS output.
